‹ NotesNoteEdited 2:09 am

things i can’t say out loud

19 April, 2:09 AM

1. that i still drive past the old apartment on purpose

2. that i knew exactly who would be on that roof before i went up

3. that when wren asked me where i was going i said “nowhere” and meant it as a location

4. that i have the date memorised as a passcode so i have to type it every single day

5. that i would do all of it again

‹ NotesNoteEdited 1:31 am

draft — do not send

19 April, 1:31 AM

I have started this eleven times and every version begins with your name, which is already more honesty than I managed all night.

Four years ago today I stood in the same stairwell and told you I would not do this. I want you to know I meant it then. I want you to know that meaning something and being able to keep it are apparently two completely different muscles.

Someone saw us. I don’t know who yet. I keep thinking I should be more frightened than I am.

— unsent
